headline: Julius Baer Survey Finds Most Young Heirs Unprepared for Wealth Succession
summary: A survey by Julius Baer and EY revealed that 66% of ultra-rich families' young heirs are not yet well prepared to take over trillions of dollars in wealth transfers.
why: Julius Baer is a major Swiss private bank catering to ultra-high-net-worth individuals, tracking wealth management trends.

impacts.name: Wealth Management
impacts.why: Succession challenges highlight consulting and advisory opportunities for private banks.
